checkoutExpiryHours.title: Unpaid checkout expires after (hours)
checkoutExpiryHours.description: How long a payer has to finish paying on the gateway's page, for gateways that take a time limit (Stripe at most 24 hours, JazzCash and Easypaisa at most 168); each gateway's own longest caps it. A payer who comes back later starts a new checkout from the pay page.

methodOrder.title: Order of the ways to pay
methodOrder.description: Gateway ids (stripe, paypal …) and your manual payment methods' keys in the order payers see them on the pay page, payment links and the pay button. The ones you leave out follow in the usual order: gateways, then your manual payment methods.

preferredMethod.title: Preferred way to pay
preferredMethod.description: A gateway id or a manual payment method's key, shown first and picked for the payer on payment links and the pay button (empty: the first one).
